remarks: Enjoy the convenience of Norwalk with this beautifully updated one-bedroom, one-bath condo in the well-managed Highview East Condominium. This first-floor unit features a spacious living room with a dining area, a nicely redone kitchen with granite countertops, a large bedroom with sliders leading to a private deck/yard, and a renovated full bath. Recent upgrades include new flooring, doors, crown molding, and a water heater, plus a fresh coat of paint. A stackable washer/dryer in the unit adds extra convenience. Start counting down the days until the pool and pool house open for the summer! The beautifully landscaped grounds enhance the property's appeal. A reserved parking space is included, with additional visitor spaces available. With low monthly HOA dues and a prime location near shopping, medical facilities, restaurants, parks, and beaches, this condo offers both comfort and convenience. Easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and the South Norwalk Train Station makes commuting a breeze. Don't miss your chance to make this exceptional property your new home! Please note: The association is currently at its maximum rental capacity. The unit is being sold AS IS.
